title: Rapunzel and her long hair.
lines: High in a hidden tower, deep in the forest, lived a girl.
Her name was Rapunzel.
And do you know what was very special about Rapunzel?
Her hair!
Rapunzel had golden hair that was super long.
Twenty metres long!
So long that it hung from the top of the tower all the way down to the ground.
Wow!
Rapunzel lived in the tower with Mother Gothel.
But Mother Gothel wasn't really her mummy.
She kept Rapunzel in the tower because Rapunzel's hair had a secret magic power.
When Rapunzel sang a song, her hair began to glow like a lamp.
And then everyone she touched became young and healthy again.
Rapunzel, let down your hair!
Mother Gothel always called from the bottom of the tower.
And then Rapunzel threw her long hair out of the window.
Whoosh!
And Mother Gothel climbed up.
Rapunzel was never allowed outside.
Never!
How annoying!
But she didn't get bored.
She painted the walls full of flowers and stars.
She baked cookies.
She read books.
She played the guitar.
And she had a little friend.
A little green animal, a chameleon!
A chameleon is a kind of little lizard.
His name was Pascal.
Pascal could change colour.
When he sat on a red chair, he turned red.
When he sat on a yellow flower, he turned yellow.
Peekaboo, where is Pascal?
Hee hee, there he is!
Every year, on her birthday, something wonderful happened.
In the evening Rapunzel looked out of the window.
And far away thousands of lights floated up into the sky.
They were lanterns!
Yellow, glowing lanterns that floated up like little stars.
Rapunzel dreamed of seeing those floating lights up close just once.
That was her very biggest wish.
One day someone climbed into the tower.
It was a young man.
His name was Flynn Rider.
Flynn was a funny adventurer, but also a bit of a thief.
He was running away.
Rapunzel got such a fright that she hit him on the head with her frying pan.
Bong!
Thud, down went Flynn.
Hee hee hee!
When Flynn woke up, Rapunzel said: I want to see the lights.
You have to take me there!
Flynn sighed.
Oh, all right then.
For the first time in her life Rapunzel climbed out of the tower, using her long hair as a rope.
Whoosh!
And when she stood in the grass with her bare feet, she shouted: Grass!
Real grass!
This is such fun!
On the way they met a big white horse.
His name was Maximus.
Maximus was the horse of the castle guards.
He was very tough and actually wanted to catch Flynn.
Neigh!
But Rapunzel stroked his nose and said: Be nice, Maximus.
And then Maximus became her friend too.
They had exciting adventures.
They went into an inn full of tough men, but they all turned out to have sweet dreams.
They ran away from guards.
They got stuck in a cave full of water.
Splash!
But Rapunzel's hair glowed, and that's how they found the way out.
And then at last the day came.
It was her birthday.
Flynn took Rapunzel out in a little boat on the water.
It got dark.
And then, very slowly, one light floated up.
And another one.
And another one.
Thousands of floating lights filled the sky and shone in the water.
Rapunzel had tears in her eyes, it was so beautiful.
Flynn gave her a lantern too, and together they let it float up.
Later Rapunzel found out that she was really a true princess.
The king and queen were her mummy and daddy!
They had been looking for her all those years.
Every year they let the lights go, hoping that one day she would come back.
Rapunzel went back to the castle.
She gave her mummy and daddy a big hug.
And Pascal turned happy and pink.
And Flynn and Maximus?
They stayed her best friends forever.
